description: X-OOS-Actor v1 test vector for the forms door (builder forms spec 2026-11-11 7.1): the CMS vector's format and rules (cms-actor-assertion.json) with aud forms. target is the canonical target of an F2 request; p is base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of target; h is base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 over the body bytes (empty for this GET). payloadSegment is base64url (no padding) of the UTF-8 JSON of payload, keys in the order aud, org, sub, sid, m, p, h, jti, iat, exp, ip; mac is base64url (no padding) of HMAC-SHA256 keyed by secret over the ASCII bytes of payloadSegment; header is v1. + payloadSegment + . + mac. The forms door signs with the builder door secret (WEBSITES2_CMS_SECRET); this secret is a test value only.
